one_liner: AI-powered search engine for academic research that finds and summarizes findings from 220M+ peer-reviewed papers.

auth.notes: Search summary: 'Consensus uses OAuth: the first time you connect, your MCP client opens a browser window to sign in and authorize access... supports OAuth for end users plus Bearer-token authentication for enterprise API access.' Direct fetches of docs.consensus.app and help.consensus.app both returned 403, so no verbatim quote could be captured; note this is the research-paper Consensus (consensus.app), not the unrelated proposal-software 'GoConsensus' (goconsensus.com) which shares the name.

access.notes: API/MCP exist and OAuth login is self-serve for the MCP, but whether the REST API itself is self-serve or requires an enterprise/paid plan could not be confirmed (pages 403'd on fetch).

api.evidence_quote: Official MCP server for Consensus. Search 220M+ peer-reviewed research papers from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP client.
api.notes: Vendor-published MCP server confirmed via GitHub org and consensus.app/home/mcp/ landing page. REST API also exists per help center article title 'The Consensus API'.

verdict.rationale: Consensus publishes an official OAuth-based MCP server and a documented API, though exact plan gating for the raw REST API is unverified.
